mapper.select: select p.* from sys_permission p LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur on rp.role_id = sur.role_id where sur.user_id=#{userId} and p.deleted=0

select p.* from sys_permission p LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur on rp.role_id = sur.role_id where sur.user_id=#{dto.userId} and sur.role_id=#{dto.roleId} and p.deleted=0
select p.* from sys_permission p inner join sys_tenant_permission tp on p.id = tp.permission_id where p.deleted = 0
